module purpose: This combinational block translates a 16-bit input instruction into a 32-bit instruction word by selecting a decode pattern and filling opcode, register and immediate fields. It also computes a decision for certain input patterns that forces instr_o(1) low while the remaining output bits come from the decoded word.

use-case flows.value: 32-bit instruction word built from the current 16-bit input by immediate assembly, case selection and field assignment
decision that certain input patterns force instr_o(1) to '0' instead of passing decoded(1)

conceptual assets.concept: 32-bit instruction word produced from the current 16-bit input encoding
conceptual assets.reasoning: Lines 57-58 assemble immediate forms from instr_i, lines 65-295 select decode cases and assign decoded fields from constants and instr_i slices, and lines 299-301 drive instr_o from decoded, with line 300 applying the separate qualifier on bit 1. The flow graph PATH from instr_i exits at instr_o. Integrity is Established because the consumer at the output port must receive exactly the translated 32-bit word defined by these assignments; availability is also Established because decoded gets a default value at line 62 and instr_o is continuously driven at lines 299-301 for the current instr_i.

conceptual assets.concept: Decision that the current input pattern must force instr_o(1) to '0'
conceptual assets.reasoning: illegal is given the default value 0 at line 61 and is set to 1 only by explicit input-pattern checks and fallback cases at lines 77-78, 98-100, 153-154, 180-181, 203-204, 221-222, 232-234, 245-246, 256-258, 266-267 and 289-291. Line 300 uses this decision to pass decoded(1) only when illegal = 0, otherwise forcing instr_o(1) to 0. The flow graph lists illegal as CONTROL-ONLY gating instr_o.
